name: What is the difference between an undermount sink and a drop-in sink?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an undermount sink and a drop-in sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drop-in sinks rest on top of the countertop cutout with a visible rim, making them simpler to install and compatible with almost any countertop material, including laminate. Undermount sinks mount beneath the counter surface, creating a seamless edge that allows you to wipe debris directly into the basin. However, undermount models require solid-surface counters like quartz, granite, or marble, along with specialized mounting clips and epoxy support. While drop-in models save on labor and material constraints, undermounts provide a sleeker aesthetic and easier cleanup if your counters can structurally support them.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drop-in sinks install over the counter rim and suit all surfaces. Undermount sinks sit below solid stone or quartz counters, offering a seamless look and easier cleaning.
